column2: After Hurricane Maria devastated Puerto Rico in 2017, a team of 10 IESC volunteers from Intel’s Sales and Marketing Group (SMG)
traveled to Mayaguez, on the hard-hit western side of the island, to partner with Intel customer World Wide Technologies to set
up 30 computer labs in underserved communities. Phase two of the project, scheduled for late 2020, calls for IESC volunteers to
partner with another customer, CDW, to build 30 more computer labs with 1,000 computers in underserved communities near
San Juan. The Intel Foundation matches employee contributions to assist communities around the world devastated by natural
disasters. In 2019, donations for disaster relief by our employees, business units, and the Intel Foundation totaled nearly $650,000.
